summary_en: 1.2 million shares will be cancelled as of November 30, 2026, reducing issued shares by 4.4% to 26.3 million shares.
title_en: Notice on Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 12, 2026, Taisei Oncho's board of directors resolved to cancel 1.2 million shares of treasury stock pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, effective November 30, 2026. The cancellation represents 4.4% of issued shares prior to the transaction. Following the cancellation, issued shares will total 26,329,948 shares. Prior to cancellation, the company held 2,405,588 treasury shares representing 8.74% of all issued shares; after cancellation, treasury share holdings are projected at 1,205,588 shares or 4.58% of issued shares following the reduction.
